# Generated Cmake Pico project file

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Initialise pico_sdk from installed location
# (note this can come from environment, CMake cache etc)

# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD pico2_w CACHE STRING "Board type")

# Pull in Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (must be before project)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(USBLogger C CXX ASM)

# Initialise the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# The SD library's PIO SPI fallback: tf_card.c refers to it, but it claims nothing on our SPI0 pins.
add_subdirectory(third_party/pico_fatfs/pio/spi pio_spi)

# The folder holding the two secrets: secrets/ in the repository, or -DSECRETS_DIR=<folder>.
set(SECRETS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/secrets CACHE PATH "folder holding log_key.txt and card_password_hash.txt")

# The log key (tools/make_secret.py log-key; never committed), compiled in as TAP_LOG_KEY.
set(LOG_KEY_FILE ${SECRETS_DIR}/log_key.txt)
if(NOT EXISTS ${LOG_KEY_FILE})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No key: run  python tools/make_secret.py log-key --dir ${SECRETS_DIR}  (it writes ${LOG_KEY_FILE})")
endif()
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${LOG_KEY_FILE})
file(READ ${LOG_KEY_FILE} LOG_KEY_HEX)
string(STRIP "${LOG_KEY_HEX}" LOG_KEY_HEX)
string(LENGTH "${LOG_KEY_HEX}" LOG_KEY_LEN)
if(NOT LOG_KEY_LEN EQUAL 64 OR NOT LOG_KEY_HEX MATCHES "^[0-9a-fA-F]+$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${LOG_KEY_FILE} must hold 64 hex digits (32 bytes)")
endif()
string(REGEX REPLACE "([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F])" "0x\\1," LOG_KEY_BYTES "${LOG_KEY_HEX}")
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/log_key.h
"/* Generated by CMakeLists.txt from secrets/log_key.txt. Do not commit. */
#ifndef LOG_KEY_H
#define LOG_KEY_H
#include <stdint.h>
static const uint8_t TAP_LOG_KEY[32] = { ${LOG_KEY_BYTES} };
#endif
")

# The card password's PBKDF2 hash, salt and iteration count (tools/make_secret.py card-password);
# the password itself is never in the image.
set(CARD_PASSWORD_FILE ${SECRETS_DIR}/card_password_hash.txt)
if(NOT EXISTS ${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No card password: run  python tools/make_secret.py card-password --dir ${SECRETS_DIR}  (it writes ${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE})")
endif()
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE})
file(READ ${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE} CARD_PASSWORD_TEXT)
string(STRIP "${CARD_PASSWORD_TEXT}" CARD_PASSWORD_TEXT)
if(NOT CARD_PASSWORD_TEXT MATCHES "^pbkdf2-sha256 ([0-9]+) ([0-9a-fA-F]+) ([0-9a-fA-F]+)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE} is not what tools/make_secret.py card-password writes")
endif()
set(CARD_PASSWORD_ITERATIONS ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
set(CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_HEX ${CMAKE_MATCH_2})
set(CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_HEX ${CMAKE_MATCH_3})
string(LENGTH "${CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_HEX}" CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_LEN)
string(LENGTH "${CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_HEX}" CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_LEN)
if(NOT CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_LEN EQUAL 32 OR NOT CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_LEN EQUAL 64 OR CARD_PASSWORD_ITERATIONS LESS 1)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${CARD_PASSWORD_FILE}: a 16-byte salt, a 32-byte hash and at least 1 iteration")
endif()
string(REGEX REPLACE "([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F])" "0x\\1," CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_BYTES "${CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_HEX}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F])" "0x\\1," CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_BYTES "${CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_HEX}")
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/card_password_hash.h
"/* Generated by CMakeLists.txt from secrets/card_password_hash.txt. Do not commit. */
#ifndef CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_H
#define CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_H
#include <stdint.h>
#define CARD_PASSWORD_ITERATIONS ${CARD_PASSWORD_ITERATIONS}u
static const uint8_t CARD_PASSWORD_SALT[16] = { ${CARD_PASSWORD_SALT_BYTES} };
static const uint8_t CARD_PASSWORD_HASH[32] = { ${CARD_PASSWORD_HASH_BYTES} };
#endif
")

# The tap's firmware, three builds of the same sources (the audit log and the card are the same in all):
#   USBLogger          shipped: TAP_DEBUG=0, no console, no USB serial
#   USBLogger_debug    TAP_DEBUG=1: the USB serial console (banner, AUD lines, stats, keys)
#   USBLogger_measure  TAP_DEBUG=1, TAP_MEASURE=1: also the cycle profiles and timing splits
function(tap_firmware name measure debug)
    add_executable(${name}
            USBLogger.c
            src/usb_proto.c
            src/selftest.c
            src/capture/usb_capture.c
            src/decode/usb_decode.c
            src/parse/msc_parse.c
            src/log/audit_log.c
            src/log/store.c
            src/meta/meta_capture.c
            src/meta/meta_decoder.c
            src/meta/meta_expect.c
            src/fs/exfat_model.c
            src/log/sha256.c
            src/log/chacha20.c
            src/log/card_password.c
            src/log/sd_log.c
            src/sd/sd_card.c
            src/sense/vbus_sense.c
            # The SD card: FatFs at boot, then blocks through tf_card.c.
            third_party/pico_fatfs/tf_card.c
            third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ff.c
            third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ffsystem.c
            third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ffunicode.c
    )
    pico_set_program_name(${name} "${name}")
    pico_set_program_version(${name} "0.1")

    # The PIO sampling program for the D+/D- tap.
    pico_generate_pio_header(${name} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/capture/usb_tap.pio)

    # The console is USB CDC, in the debug builds only; the UART is not used.
    pico_enable_stdio_uart(${name} 0)
    pico_enable_stdio_usb(${name} ${debug})

    target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/capture
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/decode
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/parse
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/log
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/meta
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/fs
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/sd
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/sense
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/conf
    )

    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE
            TAP_DEBUG=${debug} TAP_MEASURE=${measure} USB_PROFILE=${measure} USB_PROFILE_DETAIL=0)

    # The wireless chip's (LED) SPI divider: 5 gives 77 MHz at 384 MHz.
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE CYW43_PIO_CLOCK_DIV_INT=5)

    # The wireless chip's driver prints its own errors; not without a console.
    if(NOT debug)
        target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE PICO_CYW43_LOGGING_ENABLED=0)
    endif()

    target_link_libraries(${name}
            pico_stdlib
            pico_cyw43_arch_none
            pico_multicore
            pico_unique_id
            pico_rand
            hardware_pio
            hardware_dma
            hardware_clocks
            hardware_spi
            hardware_flash
            hardware_adc
            hardware_watchdog
            pio_spi
    )
    pico_add_extra_outputs(${name})
endfunction()

# Core1's hot loops aligned to a word: the same idle loop moved two bytes cost 22% more cycles.
set_source_files_properties(
        USBLogger.c
        src/decode/usb_decode.c
        src/capture/usb_capture.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-falign-loops=4;-falign-jumps=4;-falign-functions=4;-fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns")

# Core1 code: byte loops must not become memcpy/memset calls, which are in flash.
set_source_files_properties(
        src/parse/msc_parse.c
        src/meta/meta_capture.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns")

# core0's copy of the decoder (meta_decoder.c) gets the same options: from flash it decodes ~30x slower.
set_source_files_properties(
        src/meta/meta_decoder.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-falign-loops=4;-falign-jumps=4;-falign-functions=4;-fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns")

tap_firmware(USBLogger 0 0)
tap_firmware(USBLogger_debug 0 1)
tap_firmware(USBLogger_measure 1 1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sd_bringup: a development firmware that brings the SD card up with the tap not running, to
# diagnose its wiring and measure its write pauses (sd_tools/sd_bringup). Block layer only.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(sd_bringup
        sd_tools/sd_bringup/sd_bringup.c
        third_party/pico_fatfs/tf_card.c
)

pico_set_program_name(sd_bringup "sd_bringup")
pico_set_program_version(sd_bringup "0.1")

target_include_directories(sd_bringup PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/conf
)

pico_enable_stdio_uart(sd_bringup 0)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(sd_bringup 1)

target_link_libraries(sd_bringup
        pico_stdlib
        hardware_clocks
        hardware_spi
        pio_spi
)

pico_add_extra_outputs(sd_bringup)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sd_format: a development firmware that formats the SD card FAT32 after an explicit 'F' (sd_tools/sd_format).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(sd_format
        sd_tools/sd_format/sd_format.c
        third_party/pico_fatfs/tf_card.c
        third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ff.c
        third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ffsystem.c
        third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/ffunicode.c
)
pico_set_program_name(sd_format "sd_format")
target_include_directories(sd_format PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/third_party/pico_fatfs/fatfs/conf
)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(sd_format 0)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(sd_format 1)
target_link_libraries(sd_format pico_stdlib hardware_spi hardware_clocks pio_spi)
target_link_options(sd_format PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=disk_write -Wl,--wrap=disk_read -Wl,--wrap=disk_ioctl)
pico_add_extra_outputs(sd_format)
